svg.title: 8-Puzzle search tree (BFS)
svg.text: Partial search tree: 20 of 54 nodes drawn (all nodes up to depth 2 plus the whole solution path and its alternatives).
Dashed boxes stand for branches that exist in the tree but are not drawn.
BFS search: 54 nodes generated, 20 expanded, goal at depth 5.
number = order in which the search expanded the node
Each node is a board; the blue cell is the blank.
Edge label = direction in which the blank moves (Up, Down, Left, Right).
